SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.unansntabrd.mapper.BbsopcListMapper.selectBbsopcList : (모바일)카카오톡 오픈채팅 게시판목록 */ count(*) FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM , AA.BBSCTT_CN , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID , AA.FRST_REG_DT , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT , '1' AS NUM FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18'
AND BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'||#{FRST_RGTR_ID}||'%'
AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%'
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
UNION SELECT BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BB.RETE_TTL_NM , BB.RETE_CN , BB.FRST_RGTR_ID , BB.FRST_REG_DT , BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT , '2' AS NUM FROM AYE120 AS BB WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18'
AND BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%' /*게시글제목명*/
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'||#{FRST_RGTR_ID}||'%' /*작성자명*/
AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%' /*게시글번호*/
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
) AS EE ORDER BY EE.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ASC , EE.NUM

SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT) AS NAME /* 상담원명, 상담원아이디 */ , CC.USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ FROM AYC100 AA , SCA100 BB , SAA200 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} AND AA.USER_ID = CC.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO
